tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon observations show positive gain, but the candidate mechanism predicts reversal around H ≈ 15–25. A slow-horizon observation is needed to distinguish that law and validate the target forecast.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-horizon reversal law from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations are at H ≤ 0.48, far below the forecast horizon 19.2; short-window data cannot reliably identify the slow adaptation timescale or confirm the predicted reversal.
A denser batch is less directly informative about long-horizon behavior than a discriminating probe at a slow horizon.
It is unrelated to the unresolved horizon dependence and is explicitly not worth acquiring.
